# UCOS — Capability Catalog

**Artifact ID:** CTX-CAP-001
**Status:** Baseline scaffold (bootstrap) — **authoritative content generated by Prompt 02/03**.
**Purpose:** Register the business capabilities UCOS provides, independent of implementation.

> IMPORTANT: During bootstrap, capabilities are **provisional candidates** that seed
> enterprise/domain architecture generation. They are NOT finalized commitments.

---

## 1. Capability Taxonomy (provisional)

### Core Commerce Capabilities
| Cap ID | Capability | Provisional Outcome |
|--------|------------|---------------------|
| CAP-CAND-01 | Product Catalog Management | Maintain sellable product information |
| CAP-CAND-02 | Pricing & Promotion | Determine accurate, contextual prices |
| CAP-CAND-03 | Inventory & Availability | Know what can be sold and where |
| CAP-CAND-04 | Cart & Checkout | Assemble and confirm purchase intent |
| CAP-CAND-05 | Order Orchestration | Manage the order lifecycle end-to-end |
| CAP-CAND-06 | Payment Processing | Capture and settle monetary value |
| CAP-CAND-07 | Fulfillment & Returns | Deliver goods/services and handle returns |
| CAP-CAND-08 | Customer Management | Maintain customer relationships |

### Cross-Cutting / Platform Capabilities
| Cap ID | Capability | Provisional Outcome |
|--------|------------|---------------------|
| CAP-CAND-09 | Identity & Access Management | Authn/authz and tenancy |
| CAP-CAND-10 | Configuration & Metadata | Drive variability without code forks |
| CAP-CAND-11 | Observability | Logs, metrics, traces, health |
| CAP-CAND-12 | Integration & Eventing | Contract-based messaging and webhooks |
| CAP-CAND-13 | Analytics & Reporting | Insight from commerce events |
| CAP-CAND-14 | Experience Delivery | Channels and surfaces for users |

### Platform Governance Capabilities (ratified — AD-0012)
These are **ratified** first-class capabilities (not provisional candidates), with strict 1:1
domain ownership. They resolve finding DF-001 by giving the governance/platform domains direct
capability lineage.

| Cap ID | Capability | Purpose / Outcome | Realized By |
|--------|------------|-------------------|-------------|
| CAP-15 | Platform Governance | Govern the governance system itself (frameworks, lifecycle, enforcement, evolution) | ADOM-22 Governance |
| CAP-16 | Compliance & Assurance | Verification, assurance, audit coordination, regulatory conformance | ADOM-23 Compliance |
| CAP-17 | Security & Trust | Protect platform integrity, confidentiality, availability, trustworthiness; risk reduction | ADOM-24 Security |
| CAP-18 | Policy & Decisioning | Govern behavior via policy lifecycle, evaluation, decision governance, enforcement | ADOM-25 Policy |
| CAP-19 | Registry & Discovery | Authoritative registration, discovery, and metadata governance | ADOM-27 Registry |

> Required attributes (maturity, dependencies, KPIs/SLAs) and value-stream/ASR linkage for
> CAP-15..19 are completed under Prompt 02 (Trusted Operation). See AUTH-006 §6 and AD-0012.

## 2. Capability Attributes (to be completed by generators)
For each ratified capability: maturity, owning domain(s), dependencies, SLAs, KPIs — **TBD**.

## 3. Rules
1. Every capability MUST be realized by one or more domains/services and traced accordingly.
2. No capability ships without quality, security, and documentation gates passed.
3. Capability ratification occurs via the enterprise/domain generators (Prompts 02–03).
